Condition: Cold plug and slow VBUS droop with both chargers enabled and one or both packs absent; include firmware reset and absent firmware
Acceptance: Release only if approved source/connector limits bound both branch currents plus inrush in every accessible mode
Evidence_Required: Source mode agreement and synchronized port/branch current records plus BQ25180 register defaults and readback

Condition: Differential pack states through dock insertion/removal and load steps plus watchdog and approved NTC fault injection
Acceptance: Pack and PCM current and temperature limits hold and no uncommanded cross-charge; verify right load isolation and Class-D mute during charge
Evidence_Required: Signed pack/NTC curves with both signed-direction current traces and temperature sweep

Condition: Nominal and maximum expected bridge load on assembled FPC at temperature extremes
Acceptance: Each P2/P3 contact stays at or below min(0.24 A and applicable derated limit) and total drop fits regulator margins
Evidence_Required: Contact-by-contact shunt waveforms and heating with measured harness resistance

Condition: Cold boot and coincident Wi-Fi/BLE/audio burst with lowest approved VSYS and highest expected load
Acceptance: Rail and enable stay inside vendor limits without unintended reset and SWD and host recover after intended reset
Evidence_Required: Probed rail/current transients and boot logs

Condition: LED nominal PVT and lens visibility plus open/short/out-of-window and partial-power conditions
Acceptance: Approved current and optical visibility precede every captured frame; faults disable all three rails independently of the host and prevent backfeed or frame capture
Evidence_Required: LED vendor current and visibility characterization through the actual bezel plus calibrated scope and frame capture with selected camera

Condition: Start from unpowered with adapter absent using left pack only then right pack only and both with differential SOC
Acceptance: Characterize U3_L rising POR separately from running UVLO and ensure approved cold-start minimum at IC includes source impedance and pack sag
Evidence_Required: Pack emulator and measured start/inhibit brownout recovery and input-current records across qualified corners

Condition: DC bias over current and temperature plus transient and overload behavior on fitted candidate
Acceptance: 1.51-2.90uH effective inductance during specified operation; verify limit overshoot and thermal rating with actual BOM and loop
Evidence_Required: Vendor bias data and current waveforms plus thermal and assembly clearance evidence

Condition: Cold start and partial VSYS drop recovery with fastest and slowest source ramps and actual MPNS/load
Acceptance: Supply-order guarantee before D2 application requires both core and PLL at least 0.5V; prove 0.6-10V/ms and VPP/CRESET_B requirements separately
Evidence_Required: Source-qualified sequencing circuit and simultaneous near-ball traces at C2/B2/D2/D4 with approved reset and configuration timing

Condition: Start and restart Y1 at rail/temperature limits with actual input load
Acceptance: Y1 startup within 5ms under datasheet conditions and input levels/loading/recovery meet both vendor contracts

Condition: Default no-panel assembly with U6_OPT_AVDD and both J_DISP unpopulated; inject reset/config failure/first CDONE only/VSYNC loss/static D3/clock loss and short OFF-ON
Acceptance: False startup edges cannot qualify; measure latency to EN below 0.30V across corners with documented equivalent input leakage and probe loading
Evidence_Required: Time-correlated stimuli and TP_AVDD_SAFE 1-7 waveforms; separately record unloaded control test and representative load condition

Condition: Only on a controlled approved U6 plus equivalent-load fixture with abrupt and slow VSYS or 1V8 loss and repeated pre-discharge restart
Acceptance: Demonstrate JBD rail discharge and off-time envelope and exclude IO injection to either eye under complete and partial power removal
Evidence_Required: Signed NDA limits and fixture plus EN/output/load-current traces with per-case deadlines

Condition: Two approved transparent optical engines and adapter continuity plus independent optical metrology
Acceptance: Matching validated FPC pinout and vendor power protocol with independently observed left and right image timing and optical transmission
Evidence_Required: Controlled original vendor pin and protocol data with host traces and optical measurement
